title: Electric Crystal Ball
description: A glowing crystal ball sits on a cracked metallic base with purple and teal accents. Inside, bright blue and pink electrical arcs connect to a floating smiley face orb while a human finger touches the glass from the right, creating a burst of light and sparks.
prompt: A surreal glowing crystal ball on a cracked metallic base, vibrant blue and magenta electricity arcing inside the transparent sphere, a neon yellow smiley face floating at the top, a human finger touching the glass causing a bright spark burst, magical sparks and energy, dark moody background with blue liquid on the surface, cinematic lighting, digital painting style
